mainEntity.name: What factors affect the cost of pocket door installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of pocket door installation varies based on several factors, including the type of door material, the complexity of opening up or modifying the wall, and whether the existing wall needs significant structural work or relocation of electrical/plumbing. For Hometelligent Inc., projects within Alameda, Albany, or Berkeley might have different logistics compared to more distant service areas, potentially influencing overall project costs due to travel or material sourcing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation cost depends on door material, wall complexity, and potential structural/utility relocation. Location within our service area can also affect logistics and cost.
